edits.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Edit target: existing dedicated four-frame MA mage animation atlas. Make a CLEAN PIXEL-ART production candidate of the SAME four poses, SAME character identity and SAME long crescent staff. Do not invent a new design.
Pixel craft: hand-placed 16-bit tactical RPG sprite clusters, flat opaque color steps, hard stepped outlines, NO painted gradients, NO anti-aliasing, NO semitransparent colored halo. Restrained coherent palette, three-tone cloth ramps, grouped hair highlights rather than tiny noise, visible amber eyes and readable face. Purple crescent hat, long magenta hair, violet and gold layered outfit, white sleeves, brown boots. Preserve adult 4.5-head proportions. Simplify chains/filigree but preserve crescent silhouette and blue orb.
Consistency: all four faces/head sizes and torso/boot sizes match. Staff is ONE rigid full-length object, identical golden crescent/blue orb/dark shaft/ferrule, same length in every frame, never shortened. Frame 2 lower left shows TWO separate hands wrapped at two separated grip points with connected forearms, extending staff forward. Other frames retain distinct hands, one holding and one free.
Layout: preserve four poses and positions on a 2x2 equal-cell tall transparent canvas. Frame0 top-left ready; frame1 top-right anticipation; frame2 bottom-left two-handed release; frame3 bottom-right recovery. Every whole silhouette stays within its own cell with generous empty margins. Boots on same local baseline. No weapon/cape touches center seams. No extra poses, no labels, grid, floor, shadows or background. Actual transparent background, opaque character interior. Crisp pixel clusters at sprite scale, not smooth anime illustration.
edits.decision: rejected: low-alpha residues increased; retained as a failed art study only, never integrated into the game

edits.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the four-frame KA woman knight sword animation atlas. Preserve SAME four poses, same positions, same complete ONE-HANDED LONGSWORD, clear TWO hands, adult proportions, amber eyes, auburn ponytail, ivory/gold armor, crimson cape and star brooch. Do not redesign character or recompose the layout.
Redraw as clean hand-placed 16-bit tactical RPG PIXEL SPRITES with hard stepped edges, grouped pixel clusters and consistent face/head/armor/boot scale across all four frames. Reduce noisy gold decoration and micro highlights, use three-tone armor/cloth ramps with clear material separation. NO smooth gradients, painterly shading, anti-aliased colored fringe or stray pixels. Readable eyes, coherent hair locks. Keep sword rigid with consistent full blade length in all poses, do not shorten it for the forward thrust. Same body scale, full boots planted at same relative baseline.
Keep a very wide transparent cross gutter like original, exact 2x2 layout; no sprite or sword may cross into neighboring cell. Entire sword/cape fits each cell with margins. Solid opaque subject pixels, true alpha-zero empty space. No halo, background, floor, shadows, labels or grid.
edits.decision: rejected: face/material detail simplified too far; not integrated

edits.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. EDIT TARGET: the dedicated four-frame KA greatblade atlas. Retain the SAME adult female knight, amber eyes, auburn high ponytail, ivory/gold armor, crimson cape, star brooch and WIDE two-handed greatblade with golden crossguard and red gem.
Clean detailed 16-bit tactical RPG pixel craft: crisp stepped edges, hand-placed grouped color clusters, three-tone fabric and metal ramps, fewer scattered highlight pixels, readable face/eyes. NO soft painted gradients, smooth antialiasing, colored transparency halos or stray pixels. Same face, head size, torso length, gauntlets and boots across all four poses. Keep full rigid greatblade length and thickness consistent. TWO clearly separate hands must wrap the same handle in every pose, visible connected forearms, no free hand while using two-handed sword.
Preserve poses: top left high ready; top right both hands raised in overhead anticipation; bottom left powerful two-handed diagonal down-right strike; bottom right low follow-through with both hands on hilt. Preserve 2x2 composition with complete bodies, boots, capes and weapons. Place each whole silhouette strictly inside its own cell with transparent margins on ALL sides; especially lower left sword tip must end BEFORE central vertical seam. Scale whole actors uniformly if necessary; never shorten the blade. Same boot baseline per cell. Full subject opaque, background genuinely transparent. No particles, halos, background, floor, shadow, labels or grid.
edits.decision: rejected: colored fringe and cell-boundary issues remain, no sufficient benefit; not integrated
